## Change and evidence

What changed and why? Link affected entries and any related issue. Apply the [requirements for the work involved](https://github.com/luvLunairs/theory-research-atlas/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#requirements-by-work-type): ordinary checks for routine maintenance; exact source passages for curation; claims, evidence and limits for scientific contributions; affected safeguards and checks for sensitive maintenance. Link existing notes instead of copying them.

## Checks

Report actual checks, results and anything unchecked. Follow [Edit and check files](https://github.com/luvLunairs/theory-research-atlas/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#edit-and-check-files); structured changes require `python scripts/check.py --render`.

## Credit and AI assistance

Credit sources, contributors and third-party reuse terms. State **No AI assistance**, or briefly identify the tool/model if known, its role and actual checks. This suffices for maintenance, source curation and presentation that preserves meaning. AI assistance with scientific substance needs the [research assistance note](https://github.com/luvLunairs/theory-research-atlas/blob/main/docs/ai-contributions.md#one-assistance-note); link an existing note for this version.

The model restrictions apply to **scientific content and its supporting code and evidence**, including within a maintenance PR. If these contain a non-recommended or unidentified model's contribution, complete [full-text human review](https://github.com/luvLunairs/theory-research-atlas/blob/main/docs/ai-contributions.md#full-text-human-review) and submit the whole contribution manually. Unrelated maintenance can be submitted separately. All automation needs authorization and the [final-version recheck](https://github.com/luvLunairs/theory-research-atlas/blob/main/AGENTS.md#required-recheck). Sensitive maintenance receives targeted assessment in the existing PR review; no research-model qualification is required.

- [ ] I may share this material under the [contribution terms](https://github.com/luvLunairs/theory-research-atlas/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#evidence-and-attribution) and [licenses](https://github.com/luvLunairs/theory-research-atlas/blob/main/LICENSE.md). I have supplied required credit and disclosures, identified unchecked claims and followed the review and submission rules.

Maintainers: apply the [merge requirements](https://github.com/luvLunairs/theory-research-atlas/blob/main/docs/maintaining.md#merge-a-pull-request) to the final revision.
